notes.title: New Build 1.1.1.7672 Going Live tonight!
notes.content:
PLEASE NOTE: land carefully; if someone dies while you land, you will jump out. This bug has been fixed for early next week - but the two BIGGEST fixes are you may join other's maps with ease, and second, the game is much faster.


Enjoy the massive features changes - Unity Logo will go away shorty.

Engine Changes (unity 4 to Unity 5):
[list]
[*]Massive Physics upgrade (Performance and quality) Nvidia PhysX Updated from 2 to 3.
Lighting, Reflections, and Rendering Quality has improved significantly.
General Performance Increase (Higher Frame Rate)
[/list]
General Changes:
[olist]
[*]Occlusion Rebaked (faster frame rate)
[*]Ladder Climbing Recoded
[*]General Code efficiencies have increased performance and minimized bugs.
[*]Sky and Dynamic Time of Day systems are updated and improved.
[*]Lagoon Tutorial Sequence has been thoroughly debugged.
[*]Ceres Level has been added to Test Maps.
[*]Many Shaders and Materials have been updated and improved.
[*]The Music Playlist has been modified.
[*]Room Selection Screen Menus have been improved.
[*]Pause Menu UI has been improved.
[*]Artemis (Hovercraft Vehicle) has been added.
[*]Starting Care Package has more objects.
[*]Shift Key Makes Lander Lower Faster
[*]Stun Gun (Creative Mode Only “/creative” in chat)
[*]Middle Mouse Button(mappable) Rotated character towards camera.
[/olist]
Networking/Multiplayer Changes:
[olist]
[*]Creating and Joining Rooms has been debugged and should work smoothly and consistently now.
[/olist]


Coming Very Soon (Next Build)
[list]
[*]Star Raiders - they *may* not be "bad" guys. ;) Just different.
[*]Permanent Multi-Building Structure on Every Map in Campaign Mode  = SUPER HAB
[*]Permanent Joinable Mars Level - Mars One 
[/list]

Good old Notch did something similar back in the day [Minecraft], and since I once crashed his party in San Francisco where he had hired the supergroup "NERO" for his own music, he must know a thing or two.

Tutorial Dying.
Space Shuttle may still be hiding in orbit level - a 50% chance.
